findings.statement: Galacta: The Battle for Saturn was released in November 1992 on DOS and was published by Albino Frog Software, Inc.
The DOS version credits Sean Michael Puckett (design, graphics, programming), Rocco Caputo (testing, inspiration, ideas), and Terri L. Puckett (tolerance, understanding, affection).
The game has a top-down perspective, action genre, arcade shooter gameplay, shareware business model, keyboard input, and 1 offline player.
